scope: Repository-local guidance, agent capabilities, operational script contracts, knowledge/history/coordination routing, paper and administrative reference collections. Source edits owned only within .agents/skills.
coverage: Read all seven local SKILL.md bodies, .codex config and scout role, root README/ARCHITECTURE, docs/knowledge index and five substantive notes, docs/history and coordination indexes, selected audit/reviewer/report excerpts, scripts/README and selected implementation headers, paper/submission indexes and note excerpts. Searched maintained Markdown/JSON callers for local skills, graph renderers, receipt verifier and usage/feature helpers; inspected Claude adapter targets. Discovered 604 history files without reading most. Operational scripts mostly contract/header inspection; no producers, remote services, credentials, daemon/config changes, release builds, account mutations or full theorem audits. Historical records, currently selected state and unselected proposals are intentionally distinct. Installed skill copy comparison limited to existence/content equality for names shared with agent-skills package; global/plugin guidance not edited.
